items.question: Tolle Accounting's employee manual states that constructive disagreements are part of an ---- office culture.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：空格位于冠词 an 与名词 office culture 之间。 选择理由：需要形容词effective修饰culture，C正确。正确答案：C（effective）。
items.evidence: 参考原文第 1 段第 1 句：Tolle Accounting's employee manual states that constructive disagreements are part of an ---- office culture.
choice_translations: C：有效的；富有成效的（形容词）
